biggest_catch: The incentive can be clawed back: the new membership must remain open for 12 months after opening, or the incentive will be revoked and deducted from the remaining account balance.
catches: Earn $25 for each successful referral; earn up to $100 per month (limit 4 referrals per member per month).
Referred member must qualify for membership for the $25 incentive to be distributed to either party; all accounts are subject to the normal approval process and must be in good standing.
New membership must remain open for 12 months after opening or the incentive will be revoked and deducted from the remaining account balance.

Referral geography limited: friends and family who live or work in Adams, Cumberland, Franklin, Fulton, or York County (PA), excluding West Shore, Camp Hill, East Pennsboro, Mechanicsburg, and Cumberland Valley.
Program may be terminated, terms revised, or bonuses refused at 1st Ed's discretion.
